title: September Cup 2026
html:
September Cup is now open for registration
Scheduled cup time is September 26th - 20:00 CEST.

Please register > here <

Every registration has to be confirmed by one of the Orga Team members - so don't worry if your nickname does not show up immediately after registration.

The 1st round is a qualification for the final round
Registration will be closed and the seeding for the 1st round tables will be generated randomly at September 26th - 18:30 CEST.

Final round with gold, silver, bronze table takes place after 1st round has finished.

The top 3 of each final table get an award in the hall of fame.

Monthlycup Series ranking points are calculated this way.
Table settings are here.

Enjoy the CUP!
Table Admins: sp0ck, Jogy, The Dude, xTriXplEx, akia, il Buono
